title: Simple Safezones
description: Simple Safezones is a plugin that sets up save zones—such as a spawn point—and allows you to configure what a player can do within that area.
body:
Simple Safezones is a plugin that sets up save zones—such as a spawn point—and allows you to configure what a player can do within that area.

# Features
- Create a Savezones.
- Modify the Permission.
  
# Commands
- `/savezone create/credits/delete/flag/pos1/pos2/reload`
  
**aliass** `/sz` `/szone`

The SimpleSafezone plugin is an essential tool if you want to set up a server like an SMP server, because it lets you create zones and configure permissions. It’s also very useful for other types of servers, such as FFA servers. Try out the plugin now and see for yourself.

# Bug
If you find any bugs, just report them on Discord.
